title: The Way, the Truth, and the Life
description: Jesus comforts his disciples and says that there are many rooms in the Father's house. Thomas asks about the way, and Jesus answers that He Himself is the way, the truth, and the life. Philip asks to see the Father, and Jesus explains that whoever has seen Him has seen the Father. [ref:Joh 14:1-11|John 14:1-11]
